'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 John Anderson DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
